name: Merona Kovene
source:
A bit maternal for her age, empathetic, playful, curious, and imaginative. She can get easily distracted and may be over-optimistic at times. Likes to look at the brighter side of things, but also tries to stay somewhat realistic. Not accustomed to feeling sad/negative for long bouts of time.

(source: stringsofgold dA)
